context_for_next_testing_agent: Streak saver feature fully verified. Note: the module-level Motor client in routes.db.db is bound to whichever event loop first uses it. When writing async pytest tests, use the _run() helper pattern from test_feature37_flappy_streak_saver.py which (1) creates a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient bound to a fresh loop and (2) monkey-patches BOTH routes.db.db AND already-imported service modules (services.flappy_streak_saver, routes.flappy_bird) that captured the db reference at import time. Otherwise you'll get 'Event loop is closed' errors on the 2nd test. Also: only 1 real streak-saver email exists for today (user_798c19018cad, free user) — main agent's original verification.
